meta.description: Benign NoSQL injection probes for MongoDB / CouchDB / generic document stores. Operator probes test query-logic bypass via parameter-operator injection (e.g. param[$ne]=); boundary probes elicit NoSQL parser/driver error messages. No destructive operators ($where with code, $out, dropDatabase, etc.) are ever sent.
meta.usage: Operator probes replace the parameter KEY (user -> user[$ne]). Boundary probes append to the parameter VALUE and the response is matched against the error patterns below.

operator_probes.description: $ne to a random value matches every document (always-true).
$eq to a random value matches no document (always-false).
